findings.claim: The required desktop fresh-install acceptance test is still missing: the new test exercises a tools-dev web runtime, not the packaged Electron application.
findings.evidence: Criterion 2 requires a fresh install on desktop to start a local agent run without sign-in, balance dialogs, or upstream network calls, asserted by a network-denied e2e. This test constructs createToolsDevSuite(), calls runtime.startWeb(env), and opens browser.newContext(); it never launches Electron or the packaged launcher. The packet's Round-3 decision explicitly confirms that a packaged/Electron fresh-install e2e is NOT yet written. Consequently, the test does not exercise the changed packaged child-environment propagation, launcher telemetry configuration, or desktop updater in the required end-to-end flow.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a network-denied packaged/Electron fresh-install test that launches the actual desktop application under the knowdesign profile, selects and runs a local agent through its UI, and records browser and launcher/daemon egress; retain a profile-off control.
